source: awardwallet.com + frequentmiler.com + point.me + upgradedpoints.com + nerdwallet.com + 10xtravel.com + travel-on-points.com (Mon/Thu refresh; ≥4-source = auto-publish direct to main, 2-3 = review)

bonuses.conditions: Citi ThankYou Points transfer to Flying Blue at a 1:1 base ratio; the 20% bonus lifts it to 1:1.2 (1,000 points → 1,200 Flying Blue miles). Applies to the Strata Elite, Strata Premier, Prestige and AT&T Access More cards; select no-annual-fee Citi cards transfer at a lower base rate. Minimum 1,000 points per transfer; ends 11:59pm ET Aug 22.
Step-down from the 100% bonus that ended Jul 30. Chase Ultimate Rewards transfer to IHG at a 1:1 base ratio; the 70% bonus lifts it to 1:1.7.

Capital One miles transfer to Avianca LifeMiles at a 1:1 base ratio; the 15% bonus lifts it to 1:1.15 (1,000 miles → 1,150 LifeMiles). Minimum 1,000 miles per transfer. LifeMiles has recently repriced some awards — verify redemption pricing before transferring.

Chase Ultimate Rewards transfer to Aeroplan at a 1:1 base ratio; the 20% bonus lifts it to 1:1.2 (1,000 points → 1,200 Aeroplan points). Minimum 1,000 points per transfer. Your Aeroplan name must match the name on the Chase card account. Separately, Chase Aeroplan co-brand cardmembers get a standing extra 10% on transfers of 50,000+ points (capped at 25,000 bonus points per calendar year), which stacks with this promo for up to 30% — that standing perk is a card benefit, not part of this bonus.

Amex Membership Rewards transfer to British Airways at a 1:1 base ratio; the 30% bonus lifts it to 1:1.3 (1,000 points → 1,300 Avios). The same promo covers Iberia and Aer Lingus Avios, which Point Bandit does not yet model as Membership Rewards routes.

Registration is required before your first transfer. Citi ThankYou Points transfer to Asia Miles at a 1:1 base ratio; the 10% bonus lifts it to 1:1.1. The bonus is capped at 10,000 bonus miles per member across all participating partners combined, so the most you can earn is on about 100,000 points transferred. Bonus miles post roughly 12 weeks after the base miles credit. Ends 11:59pm PT Aug 28.

Registration is required before your first transfer. Amex Membership Rewards transfer to Asia Miles at a 5:4 base ratio (Amex devalued this route from 1:1 on Mar 1, 2026), so the 10% bonus lifts it to 5:4.4 — 1,000 points become 880 Asia Miles, not 1,100. The bonus is capped at 10,000 bonus miles per member across all participating partners combined, which takes about 125,000 Amex points to reach because of the reduced ratio. Bonus miles post roughly 12 weeks after the base miles credit. Ends 11:59pm PT Aug 28.

Citi ThankYou Points transfer to Turkish Miles&Smiles at a 1:1 base ratio; the 40% bonus lifts it to 1:1.4 (1,000 points → 1,400 miles). The promotion is run by Turkish Airlines, not Citi, so it does not appear on the Citi transfer page. No registration required. Capped at 50,000 bonus miles per member (reached at 125,000 points transferred). Bonus miles are processed by Turkish after the transfer posts and credit after the campaign ends Aug 31.
